sources.title: National Holidays and other Public Holidays Act (Cap. 252), as legislation.mt serves it (its PDF, getpdf/6045db8471043016743df577), consolidated to 12/02/2021; gov.mt and dier.gov.mt answer this environment with a Cloudflare block
sources.said: 2. The following shall be National Holidays: the twenty first day of September known as Jum l-Indipendenza, the thirteenth day of December known as Jum ir-Repubblika, the thirty first day of March known as Jum il-Ħelsien, the eighth of September known as Jum il-Vittorja, the seventh day of June known as the Sette Giugno. 5. (1) Sundays and the days listed in the Schedule shall be public holidays. Schedule, List of Public Holidays (in addition to National Holidays and Sundays): 1st January New Year’s Day; 10th February Feast of St. Paul’s Shipwreck; 19th March Feast of St. Joseph; Good Friday; 1st May Workers’ Day; 29th June Feast of St. Peter and St. Paul; 15th August Feast of the Assumption; 8th December Feast of the Immaculate Conception; 25th December Christmas Day. (c) with effect from 1st January 2021, when a national holiday or a public holiday listed in the Schedule falls on a Saturday or on a Sunday, it shall be deemed to be a public holiday for the purposes of entitling any person to a day of vacation leave in addition (a day of leave, not a day off for all: no substitute).
